task: Who's got a virtual machine and is about to play through an life changing round of TextWorld? You do! Here is how to play! First of all, you could, like, head west. Then, take a trip west. If you can get around to doing that, take a trip west. If you can finish that, make an attempt to head south. And then, make an effort to go east. Then, try to go east. Then, recover the loaf of bread from the rack in the laundromat. And once you've done that, you win!
description:
You find yourself in a vault. A standard one. Okay, just remember what you're here to do, and everything will go great.

You scan the room for a table, and you find a table. The table is typical. On the table you make out a latchkey.

There is an open passageway leading south. You need an unblocked exit? You should try going north. There is an unblocked exit to the west.
